Risk: Customer concentration: top 3 customers represent over 40% of ARR
Mitigation: Diversify customer base; offer multi-year contracts to top customers; expand into adjacent segments

Risk: Key person dependency on CTO for technology roadmap
Mitigation: Implement retention package; document architecture and roadmap; identify and develop successor

Risk: Open source license compliance: GPL components detected in production
Mitigation: Conduct full open source audit; replace GPL components with permissive alternatives; document license obligations

Risk: SOC 2 Type II report has 2 noted exceptions in access control
Mitigation: Implement MFA for all admin access; complete access review process; remediate before next SOC 2 audit

Risk: Material contract change-of-control provision: top 5 customers require consent
Mitigation: Pre-clear consents where possible; structure deal to minimize consent requirements; build consent playbook

Risk: Pending litigation: $5M exposure in employment matter
Mitigation: Defense counsel engaged; mediation scheduled; reserve booked; insurance coverage confirmed

Risk: FY2024 audit opinion: qualified due to revenue recognition cutoff
Mitigation: Remediated cutoff procedures for FY2025; auditor review confirmed; expect clean opinion

Risk: Cloud spend: AWS costs growing faster than revenue (3x revenue growth)
Mitigation: Reserved instance commitments; implement cost monitoring; right-size non-production environments

Risk: GDPR: 47% of EU customer data lacks explicit consent records
Mitigation: Update consent flows; conduct DPIA; engage EU privacy counsel; remediation plan in progress

Risk: Equity overhang: 25% of fully diluted shares in option pool not yet granted
Mitigation: Plan for refresh grants; communicate equity philosophy to team; consider pool expansion at next round

Risk: Sales pipeline coverage: 2.1x for next quarter (target is 3.0x)
Mitigation: Pipeline generation initiatives; SDR hiring; outbound campaign; review top deals weekly

Risk: Single-source supplier: dependency on Provider X for core analytics feature
Mitigation: Identify backup provider; develop in-house alternative; negotiate improved SLA with current provider

Risk: Insurance: D&O policy lacks adequate tail coverage for prior management
Mitigation: Procure 6-year D&O tail; review with broker; budget for closing cost

Risk: Data breach in 2023: 12K customer records exposed, fully remediated
Mitigation: Fully remediated; insurance claim closed; SOC 2 confirmed controls; reported to authorities

Risk: Founder vesting: founders have 4-year vests with 1-year cliffs, mostly fully vested
Mitigation: No acceleration; risk is departure, not vesting; consider post-close retention grants

Risk: Working capital seasonality: Q4 NWC spikes 30% above average
Mitigation: Document seasonality in NWC target; consider trailing 12-month average approach

Mitigation: Begin lease renewal or relocation discussions; confirm consent requirements post-close

Mitigation: Tax reserve booked; outside counsel review; voluntary disclosure analysis underway

Risk: IP: trademark opposition pending in EU for company name
Mitigation: Trademark counsel engaged; opposition response filed; expected outcome favorable

Risk: Debt: $25M term loan has change-of-control prepayment requirement
Mitigation: Engage with lender pre-signing; explore refinancing options; budget for prepayment

Risk: Engineering attrition: 18% trailing 12 months (industry: 12%)
Mitigation: Conduct stay interviews; review compensation; implement retention bonuses for key roles

Risk: Customer concentration in single industry vertical: 60% in healthcare
Mitigation: Vertical diversification strategy; hire vertical-specific sales leaders; build adjacent verticals

Risk: Material weakness in revenue recognition: multiple element arrangements
Mitigation: New controls implemented; auditor confirmed remediation; expect clean opinion FY2025

Risk: AI/ML model: training data provenance documentation incomplete
Mitigation: Complete data provenance audit; update documentation; review with IP counsel

Risk: Cross-border data transfer: SCCs not in place for all EU-to-US transfers
Mitigation: Update DPAs with SCCs; complete transfer impact assessment; engage EU privacy counsel
